name: SNT Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: SNT Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in manufacturing and selling automobile parts and industrial facilities businesses. It offers auto parts, defense products, semiconductor equipment and materials; precision machine tools and medium-large sized casting products; axle systems; and machine tools. It also offers air coolers, heat recovery steam generators, condensers, and SCR systems for petrochemical refineries, gas plants, and generating stations. The company also operates a savings bank that provides various banking and financial products; and operates a hotel business.
